chapter.verse: Ni khat Zeisu in biakna innpi sungah mite thu hilh a, Lungdamna Thu a gen lai takin, siampi liante, laitheite leh upate ama kiangah a pai uh hi.
“Hih nate kua thu tawh bawl na hi hiam? Hih thu kua in hong pia ahi hiam?” hong hilh in ci-in a dong uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Note zong ke’n kam khat kong dong ding hi. Hong dawng un. Johan’ baptaizna thu koi pan hong piang ahi hiam?
Vantung pan hong piang ahi hiam, mi tung pan hong piang ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Amaute in, “Vantung pan hong piang hi ci leeng, ‘Note in ama thu bang hangin um lo na hi uh hiam?’ ci-in hong dong zel ding hi.
‘Mi tung pan hong piang hi ci leeng mi khempeuhte in suang tawh hong deeng ding uh hi.’ Bang hang hiam i cih leh, amaute in Johan in kamsangpa a sa uh hi,” ci-in khat leh khat a kikum uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin, “Koi pan hong piang cih ko ka thei kei uh hi,” ci-in Zeisu kiangah a gen uh ciangin,
Zeisu in, “Tua mah bangin hih nate, kua thu tawh ka bawl kong gen kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua lai takin Zeisu in hih thugentehna mihonpite kiangah a gen-inah, “Mi khat in lo lai-ah leenggah kungte suan a, lo khote khawhlawhsakin gamdang ah pai a, sawtpi a tam hi.
A hun a cin ciangin lo khawhlawhte in leenggah a piak nadingin ama nasemte khat a sawl hi. Tua lo khawhlawhte in a nasempa satin khut guak tawh a ciahsak uh hi.
Khatvei nasem dang khat sawl kik a, tua pa zong satin a zahhuaisak khit uh ciangin, khut guak tawh a ciahsak uh hi.
Khatvei nasem thumna zong sawl leuleu a, amau in tua pa satgawpin a hawlkhia uh hi.
Tua ciangin lo neipa in, ‘Bang ka ci hih ding hiam? Ka it mahmah ka tapa ka sawl ding hi. Amaute in ka tapa a zahtak kha ding uh hi,’ a ci hi.
Ahih hangin lo khawhlawhte in a tapa a muh uh ciangin, ‘Hih pa in a inn luah dingpa ahi hi. Luah na’ng teng i ngah theih nadingin amah that ni,’ ci-in khat leh khat a kikum uh hi.
Lo neipa’ tapa leenggah lo nawlah paikhiatpihin a that uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin lo neipa in lo khawhlawhte tungah bangci a bawl ding hiam?
Amah hong pai-in tua lokhawh lawhte sugawpin, a leenggah lo midangte a cingsak ding hi,” a ci hi. Amaute in hih thu a zak uh ciangin, “Tua bang hi kei hen!” a ci uh hi.
Zeisu in amaute a et lai takin, “Tua ahih leh, ‘Inn lamte in a nilkhiat suang in anung ciangin innkiu suang a piang hi,’ ci-in a kigelh thu, bang cihnopna ahi hiam?
Hih suang tungah a kiate khempeuh a kitan ding uh hi. A tungah hih suang kia a, a deen’khak peuhmahte in leivui bangin kizan gawp ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua lai takin laitheite leh siampi liante in Zeisu mat dingin a zon’ uh hangin mite a kihta uh hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, amau cihna-a hih thugentehna a gen ahih lam a thei uh hi.
Tua lai takin amaute in Zeisu ensim uh a, mangpipa’ vaihawmna leh thukhente tungah a piak nadingun, ama kampau tawh mat theih nadingin thusim kante a kiangah a sawl uh hi.
Tuate in, “Sia aw, nang in thutak genin thu na hilh a, mi khentuam nei loin Pasian’ lampi a tang takin na hilh hi cih ka thei uh hi.
Kote in Kaisar kumpipa kiangah siah piak tuak ahi hiam, piak tuak lo ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi.
Zeisu in amaute khemna a theih ciangin,
“Denarias peek khat hong lak un. Kua lim leh kua min ahi hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin, “Kaisar kumpipa’ lim leh min hi,” a ci uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Tua ahih leh Kaisar kumpipa’ sum Kaisar kumpipa na pia un; Pasian’ sum Pasian na pia un,’ a ci hi.
Amaute in mite mai-ah hih thu panin a man zo kei uh hi. Zeisu’ dawn’na thu lamdang a sa uh a, pau loin a om uh hi.
“Misite’ thawhkikna om lo hi,” a ci Saddusite kimkhat in tua lai takin Zeisu kiangah va pai uh a;
“Topa aw, ‘Mi khat in zi nei a, ta nei loin a sih leh, a nau in a zi luah hen la, a u’ khang a man’ loh nadingin kizom ta hen,’ ci-in Moses in eite lai hong pia hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, unau sagih a om uh hi. A upa pen in zi nei a, ta nei loin a si hi.
A naupa leh a thumna akipanin, unau sagihte in a teen’pih uh a, ta nei loin a si uh hi.
A nung ciangin numei zong a si hi.
Tua bang ahih leh, thawhkik ni ciangin tua numei in amaute lakah kua pen’ zi ahi ding hiam? Bang hang hiam na cih leh, tua sagihte in tua numei tawh a kiteeng uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Tu lai khang mite kiteengin, a kiteen’sak uh hangin,
hong tung ding hun leh thawhkikna ngah dinga kilawm, misite lak pana a thokik mite kipi kiteengin a om nawn kei ding uh hi.
Amaute cikmah hunin a si thei kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, amaute in vantungmite tawh kibangin, thawhkikna’ tate ahih manunah Pasian’ tate ahi ding uh hi.
Moses in sawlkawm lakah Topa a hopih lai-in ‘Abraham’ Pasian, Isaak’ Pasian, Jakob’ Pasian aw, a cih ciangin misite kithokiksak ding hi cih a lak ahi hi.
Pasian in a site’ Pasian hi loin, a nungtate’ Pasian ahi hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, mi khempeuhte in Pasian ading a nungta uh hi,” a ci hi.
Laithei kimkhatte in, “Sia aw, a kituak mahmahin na gen zo hi,” a ci uh hi.
A nung ciangin, amaute in thudang a dong ngam nawn kei uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Khazih in David’ Ta hi bangci a kici thei hiam?
David in: ‘Topa in Na galte na khe nuai-ah ka koih matengin,
Ka ziat lamah na tu in, ci-in ka Topa kiangah a ci hi,’ ci-in Late Lai Siangtho sungah a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin David in, ‘Khazih in Topa hi,’ a cih leh bangci-in ama ta hi thei ding ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Mi khempeuhte in a thu a ngaih lai takin Zeisu in a nungzuite kiangah,
“Laitheite na kikeem un. Amaute in puantual silhin a vak nuam uh hi. Sumbukah zahtakna tawh hopih ahi zongin, pawikhamna sungah tutna phabel ahi zongin a deih uh hi.
Amaute in meigongte’ neihsa a ne mang uh a, mawhna a kilat loh nadingin sauveipi thu a ngen uh hi. Tuate in mawhsakna lianzaw a thuak ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
